parameters:
I can't go this way. Something invisible is
blocking me.
list._original:
こちらには進めない。
目に見えない何かに阻まれている。

parameters:
You... you're the officer who slew that
apparition a few days ago, aren't you?
list._original:
あなたが……
あなたが数日前にあの怪異を斬ったという隊士ですね。

parameters: If you mean the Onryō, then yes.
list._original: 厭い根のことなら、いかにも。

parameters:
This area is a hotspot for them. It's no
place for a grave visit right now...
Return to the capital.
list._original:
この辺りは奴らが湧く場所。
今は墓参りには適さぬ……都へ戻れ。

parameters: The one you killed was my child!
list._original: あなたが斬ったのは私の子だった！

parameters:
I heard there was still a trace of her left! She
might have been restored!
list._original:
まだ面影が残っていたと聞いた！
元に戻れたかもしれない！

parameters: And yet... and yet you killed her.
list._original:
なのに……
なのにあなたは、殺したの。

私の子を殺した。
人殺し！！

parameters:
Once it came to that, there was no
turning back. I had to put it out of its
misery.
list._original:
ああなっては戻れぬ。
介錯する他ない。

parameters:
Because she became an apparition, she couldn't
even be buried in a normal grave. That child...
she was alone until the very end...
list._original:
怪異になったから、普通のお墓にも入れてもらえない。
あの子は、最後まで独り寂しく……

parameters:
...That other child, the one from the swamp. I
heard she was gravely injured because of you as
well.
list._original:
……例の、こそ泥の子。
あの子もあなたのせいで大怪我をしたと聞いた。

parameters:
The apparition that took human form... it was
you, wasn't it?
list._original:
人の姿をした怪異は……
他ならぬ、あなたでしょう。

parameters:
No matter how many times I fall, I rise
again.
list._original: 幾度転べど、立ち上がる。

parameters:
I can still... still stand. I can
still...
list._original:
まだ……まだ立てる。
まだ……
